mechanism: Diphenhydramine's anticholinergic properties may reduce diuretic efficacy of torsemide, while torsemide-induced electrolyte depletion increases risk of anticholinergic adverse effects and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor blood pressure, fluid status, and serum electrolytes (especially potassium); use lowest effective diphenhydramine dose and consider alternative antihistamines with minimal anticholinergic activity.
